unique_hypothesis: after the frozen two-page grace, repeated explicit rejection of a displayed attribute/value family is useful causal evidence that subsequent pages should prioritize unseen candidates outside that family; scoping this memory to one intent version and resetting the corresponding question lifecycle on an override or positive restatement can improve later-turn discovery without changing the first two pages or harming previously hit sessions

single_mechanism_boundary.baseline: frozen v2.12 fixed two-page grace over frozen v1.9/P11/R08
single_mechanism_boundary.eligible_evidence: an explicit user rejection parsed from the current or prior causal turn and attributable to a displayed attribute/value family in the same intent version
ineligible_evidence: target identifier, target attributes, hit status, future turns, evaluator labels, popularity-only inference
a generic retry with no attributable displayed family
implicit non-click, non-selection, silence, or an unanswered recommendation
an inferred product attribute that is unknown in the catalog record
single_mechanism_boundary.memory_update: increment one bounded rejection count for each explicitly rejected displayed family; deduplicate identical evidence within a turn
single_mechanism_boundary.ranking_transform: keep the frozen v2.12 unseen-first partition, then stable-partition the unseen remainder into non-rejected-family before rejected-family candidates; preserve upstream order inside each partition and use seen candidates only as the existing fallback
single_mechanism_boundary.question_reset: on every intent-version increment, cancel pending question state and reopen asked/exhausted attributes for the new version; on an explicit positive restatement of a previously rejected attribute/value family, clear only that family's negative memory before ranking
prohibited_changes: retrieval depth, P11 order, v1.9 ranker, grace-page count, question order, evaluator semantics
learned weights, target-conditioned admission, label-conditioned thresholds, new data

implementation_sequence.phase_0_contract: implement pure state/update/ordering functions and tests only; verify target blindness, causal ordering, resets, bounds, determinism, and frozen v2.12 identity when no eligible evidence exists
implementation_sequence.phase_1_runtime_shadow: wire the mechanism behind a distinct default-off mode and expose bounded diagnostics; failure must return the complete frozen v2.12 order unchanged
implementation_sequence.phase_2_smoke: run exactly one frozen 100-session cached smoke after source and protocol hashes are committed; do not run a full Agent or inspect individual targets during tuning
implementation_sequence.phase_3_nested_oof: allow one cached 2000-session nested OOF exact-repeat only when the smoke has positive net hits, zero hit-to-miss, non-regressive MRR and MTTC, and deterministic identity

contract_tests: no eligible rejection is byte-identical to frozen v2.12
the first two pages of every intent version are byte-identical to frozen v1.9
a family rejection never promotes a candidate from that same family above an otherwise-order-equivalent unseen candidate outside it
generic retry alone does not create family memory
positive restatement clears only the matching family memory before ranking
intent override clears all progressive memory and question lifecycle state before the new version's first response
duplicates and malformed attributes fail closed to frozen v2.12
Top100 membership, Top10 uniqueness, stable ties, and exact repeat are preserved

decision_queue.go: freeze and integrate only if every applicable smoke and nested-OOF gate passes
decision_queue.smoke_no_go: record No-Go without opening 2000-session outcomes; proceed to the preregistered clause-isolated C200/C400 target-blind recall probe
decision_queue.nested_oof_no_go: record No-Go and keep v2.12 as the best frozen candidate; do not tune family rules on opened outcomes
